text: In Cubical Agda, the interval I has the following De Morgan structure:
choices: ~ i, i ∧ j, i ∨ j (complement, min, max) with ~ i0 = i1
explanation: I has: complement (~ i: ~i0=i1, ~i1=i0), meet (i∧j), and join (i∨j). This is a De Morgan algebra structure, giving Cubical Agda definitional path reversal and Kan operations.
